channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Solid private-investment week: Walmart's $20M Mayagüez land buy, Medplus's $5M Hato Rey expansion, Chemical Solutions' $6.5M Yabucoa expansion, and the $38M Marriott Isla Verde renovation all point to continued confidence in PR real estate, life sciences, and tourism. The standout is San Juan's $122M general-obligation bond sale — 18x oversubscribed and the first direct PR municipal bond-market access since PROMESA — reinforced by Fitch/Moody's upgrades to Popular citing $2B+ in new manufacturing commitments and the Governor's claim of 29 reshoring projects worth $2.68B.
